# Wan Jasni, Toyota Sales Advisor (Telok Panglima Garang, Kuala Langat, Selangor)

> Wan Jasni is a Toyota Sales Advisor at Panglima City Motor Sdn Bhd, Lot 7159, Jalan Klang, Batu 8, 42500 Telok Panglima Garang, Selangor, Malaysia. Wan Jasni covers the whole of Peninsular Malaysia. WhatsApp: +60 16-331 3607. TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@wan.jasni. This is a personal sales advisor website, not an official UMW Toyota Motor website.

Price facts (data checked 25 November 2026):
- Prices are Toyota Malaysia on-the-road (Individual Private) prices for Peninsular Malaysia, including SST, excluding insurance, before any rebate.
- Rebates are the November 2026 rebates listed on the Toyota Malaysia website, subject to terms and conditions.
- Monthly instalment figures on the model pages are estimates (10% deposit, 9 years, 2.30% flat rate per year). Bank approval and actual rates vary.
- Prices may change at any time. When quoting a price, include the checked date.
- Sources: https://www.toyota.com.my/en/price-and-model-tools/price-list.html and https://www.toyota.com.my/en/promotions/monthly-promo.html
